scope: Six publicly identified works by Xiaokai (Bill) Rong; no claim about unpublished work.

works.name: CodeSteer
works.title: Post-Hoc Attention Steering of Large Language Models for Robust Code Understanding under Obfuscation
works.question: 当变量名被混淆，怎样让模型重新关注有用的代码结构？
works.summary: CodeSteer uses program-analysis relevance signals to steer model attention at inference time, improving reasoning about obfuscated code.
method_facts: Backward slices guide output prediction.
Control-flow paths guide execution reasoning.
Attention is steered toward semantically relevant elements; this is training-free.
The paper includes a buffer-overflow detection case study.
works.boundary: Teaching demonstrations use authored examples and deterministic browser logic. They do not run the paper system or reproduce its empirical evaluation.

works.name: AdaptAgent
works.title: AdaptAgent: A Multi-agent, Domain-Guided Reasoning Framework for Code Adaptation
works.question: 修改一段代码时，怎样把需求、领域上下文与验证连起来？
works.summary: Given a snippet, intent, target repository, and location, AdaptAgent coordinates specialized agents to produce an adapting patch.
method_facts: Agents exchange typed artifacts.
Intent Summarizer extracts goals; Policy Agent derives rules from six adaptation categories.
Domain Planner orders the plan; Context Miner extracts sibling-method semantics.
Code Adapter produces a minimal unified diff; compiler-based Verifier supplies iterative feedback.
works.boundary: Teaching demonstrations use authored examples and deterministic browser logic. They do not run the paper system or reproduce its empirical evaluation.

works.name: LλMDA
works.title: Large Language Model-Aided Partial Program Dependence Analysis
works.question: 只有一段不完整的代码，怎样恢复可靠的程序依赖？
works.summary: LλMDA fills missing context in partial code so conventional dependence analysis can work, then retains results relevant to the original snippet.
method_facts: Two phases: Context Augmentation and Analysis.
Compiler feedback guides missing declarations, imports, and type information.
LLMs provide context rather than directly predicting dependence edges.
Traditional analysis runs on augmented code; extra-scope results are removed.
The paper implementation uses Joern with GPT-4o or Claude 3.5 Sonnet.
works.boundary: Teaching demonstrations use authored examples and deterministic browser logic. They do not run the paper system or reproduce its empirical evaluation.

works.name: Behavioral Alignment
works.title: On Behavioral Alignment of Model-Code and Human-Code Understandability via Behavioral Proxies
works.question: 模型觉得好懂的代码，人也会觉得好懂吗？
works.summary: This work treats understandability as a relationship between code and its reader, and studies alignment between human judgments and model behavior.
method_facts: P0 is a comprehension-question behavioral proxy.
P1–P3 use program-intent summaries and semantic self-consistency.
The study compares multiple LLMs with human-rated understandability across reader groups.
Alignment is strongest with professional developers; role prompts do not resolve weaker student-group alignment.
works.boundary: Teaching demonstrations use authored examples and deterministic browser logic. They do not run the paper system or reproduce its empirical evaluation.

works.name: PredEx
works.title: Blended Analysis for Predictive Execution
works.question: 哪些代码必须执行，哪些信息可以用程序分析缩小范围？
works.summary: PredEx combines program analysis with model reasoning to predict Python execution traces.
method_facts: Deterministic control-flow steps use program analysis.
Uncertain branch decisions use per-variable predictive backward slices.
Applications include code coverage and runtime-error prediction for complete or incomplete code.
works.boundary: Teaching demonstrations use authored examples and deterministic browser logic. They do not run the paper system or reproduce its empirical evaluation.

works.name: SAFEMIN
works.title: Large Language Models for Safe Minimization
works.question: 怎样删掉冗余约束，同时保留真正导致冲突的核心？
works.summary: SAFEMIN pairs LLM proposals with SMT checking to reduce infeasible string-constraint systems while preserving unsatisfiability.
method_facts: The retained subset must remain UNSAT.
The target is a minimal unsatisfiable subset (MUS).
A sample-and-enumerate strategy explores multiple MUSes.
The paper demonstrates infeasible-path detection.
works.boundary: Teaching demonstrations use authored examples and deterministic browser logic. They do not run the paper system or reproduce its empirical evaluation.
